source: US4576724A example scaled to D2=35 mm; explicit reconstruction choices

input_provenance.d2_mm: choice: 35 mm class has published velocity (Bai 2009) and efficiency (Young 1994) data
input_provenance.n_inlets: US4576724: two equal, equally spaced tangential feeds, same sense
input_provenance.inlet_h_over_w: assumption: rectangular inlet, axial height / radial width = 2
input_provenance.inlet_z_offset_mm: assumption: inlet roof flush with the end wall
input_provenance.inlet_length_cfd_mm: CFD choice: feed channel length upstream of the tangent point
input_provenance.inlet_length_part_mm: part choice: port face 12 mm beyond the chamber radius
input_provenance.plenum_radius_mm: CFD choice: reject plenum so the overflow BC sits away from the orifice
input_provenance.head_spigot_over_d2: part choice: printed head ends 0.5 D2 into the fine taper
input_provenance.wall_thickness_mm: part choice for the printed head shell
